bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
old_tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-rich-recovery-c063
new_tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:link-mp4-document-4d24
rollback=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-link-mp4-document-20261121
local_tag=gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 60
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled || exit 61
oldid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$old_tag")" || exit 62
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 63
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$oldid" || exit 64
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$local_tag")" = "$oldid" || exit 65
docker logs --tail 240 deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -Fq 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY' || exit 66
test "$(gh run view 44822142664 -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --json headSha,conclusion --jq '.headSha+" "+.conclusion')" = "4d24f7efa0a1d7671d96408842d8cd24d12de8b4 success" || exit 67
test "$(gh run view 44822142673 -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --json headSha,conclusion --jq '.headSha+" "+.conclusion')" = "4d24f7efa0a1d7671d96408842d8cd24d12de8b4 success" || exit 68
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/gace-mp4-document.XXXXXXXX)"
swapped=0
ok=0
cleanup(){
 rc=$?
 trap - EXIT
 if test "$swapped" = 1 && test "$ok" != 1; then
  docker tag "$rollback" "$local_tag" || true
  docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 fi
 rm -rf "$tmp"
 exit "$rc"
}
trap cleanup EXIT
mkdir -p "$tmp/old" "$tmp/new" "$tmp/overlay"
gh run download 44820979550 -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot -n gaybbs-profile-bundle -D "$tmp/old" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 69
gh run download 44822142664 -R seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot -n gaybbs-profile-bundle -D "$tmp/new" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 70
docker cp deploy-gaybbs-1:/app/gaybbs.mjs "$tmp/live.mjs"
cmp -s "$tmp/old/gaybbs.mjs" "$tmp/live.mjs" || exit 71
docker run --rm --network none -v "$tmp/new:/bundle:ro" --entrypoint node "$old_tag" --check /bundle/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null || exit 72
cp "$tmp/new/gaybbs.mjs" "$tmp/overlay/gaybbs.mjs"
cat >"$tmp/overlay/Dockerfile" <<'EOF'
FROM gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
COPY --chown=1000:1000 gaybbs.mjs /app/gaybbs.mjs
EOF
docker build --pull=false --network none -t "$new_tag" -f "$tmp/overlay/Dockerfile" "$tmp/overlay" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 73
newid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$new_tag")"
test "$newid" != "$oldid" || exit 74
if docker image inspect "$rollback" >/dev/null 2>&1;then
 test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$rollback")" = "$oldid" || exit 75
else docker tag "$oldid" "$rollback";fi
docker tag "$new_tag" "$local_tag"
swapped=1
docker compose -p deploy -f "$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 76
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$newid" || exit 77
ready=0
for i in $(seq 1 14);do
 if docker logs --tail 240 deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -Fq 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY';then ready=1;break;fi
 sleep 5
done
test "$ready" = 1 || exit 78
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 79
ok=1
echo LINK_MEDIA_CLASSIFICATION_IMAGE=APPLIED
echo BOT_READY=PASS
echo USERBOT_ACTIVE=PASS
echo ROLLBACK_IMAGE_RETAINED=PASS
